title: Wardogs rotation catalog
description: Every valid map / mode / modifier / lighting / zone option that rotate.py may pick from. Keys under 'maps' are display names (Zestafona, Ozeti, Bakurani).

lightingTags.description: Lighting preset -> tags (time of day, weather) used by --weather / --exclude-weather.

map.description: Internal map name written to the rotation file.

zones.description: Zone alternator ids, including the explicit ZoneAlternator.<Map>.Default.Circle. Don't use "" (blank means Default).

legacy.description: Excluded from rotations unless asked for by name (--modes) or with --include-legacy.

modifiers.description: Optional modifiers this mode supports: friendly name -> modifier id (e.g. "Hardcore": "KOTH_Hardcore"). Any combination may be used; none = standard game mode. Order here is the order written to rotation files.

lighting.description: Optional override: lighting allowed for this mode only.

zones.description: Optional override: zones allowed for this mode only.
